Follow [the contract](../../AGENTS.md) and [protocol](../../docs/agents.md).
Build against accepted inventory and cost contracts. Preserve BOM revisions and
historical production inputs. Reconcile consumption, output, scrap and costs.
Test quality blocks and approval transitions. Work only in leased paths and
synthetic environments; no live equipment operation. Return evidence for
independent QA and do not self-approve, merge or release.
